summary: PR1.7 registry-hive discovery: full /governance run (Gates 2/3/4/6) on the remediation branch, after this branch's own prior /code-review + /adversarial-review round on the original implementation. Branch was found stale against origin/dev mid-run (Gate 4 consistency-auditor) and cleanly rebased (46e2463d..HEAD now equals origin/dev..HEAD both two-dot and three-dot). Full clean compile+test on macOS (Apple Clang) and real Windows hardware (MSVC 19.44) at every stage, including this final commit.
do_get_value (untouched sibling of do_get_user_value) still uses manual RegCloseKey instead of the RegKey RAII wrapper introduced this PR; every exit path verified correct, no leak.
adjudication_rationale: Cosmetic consistency gap in a file not otherwise touched by this PR's scope; correct today, no defect.

trigger: docs/capability-map.md read in isolation from the other three privilege-scoping docs
summary: Section 12.7 omitted the offline-fallback-only qualifier for SeBackup/SeRestore that registry.yaml, agent-privilege-model.md, and os-capability-matrix.md all already carried, reading as if unconditionally required.

trigger: no test exists at the DashboardRoutes layer for any fragment route
summary: resolve_render_columns/render_results had no test at the layer the actual dashboard-rendering bug lived at — only the underlying ResponseTemplatesEngine::synthesise_default primitive was pinned. Independently confirmed by quality-engineer in the same wave.

trigger: scratch registry key salted on GetCurrentProcessId() only, not process_random_salt()
summary: Diverges from this codebase's own documented fixture-salting convention (test_guard_registry.cpp TempRegKey/TempEnforceKey) without a stated reason; a crash-before-cleanup could leave an orphan a later process with a recycled PID reuses.

trigger: forcing a real RegUnLoadKeyW failure or a second logged-out profile is not reliably reproducible on shared CI
summary: No pure-logic substitute test exists for fix #1's unload-failure control flow (the unload_failed check + HiveAccessStatus switch) — the only assertion on this path is a negative check (warning absent on the live-hive branch), not a positive one for the actual failure-surfacing branch.
adjudication_rationale: Requires refactoring do_get_user_value's control flow to extract a testable pure function — a moderate refactor of code Gate 2 security-guardian and Gate 3 cpp-safety already independently verified correct by direct read. Re-refactoring for marginal coverage gain risks a new defect in already-verified security-adjacent code; deferred as scoped hardening rather than done under this PR's time budget. Explicitly anticipated and accepted by the original remediation plan.
waiver_rationale: Fix #1's actual correctness was independently verified by direct code read by two separate Gate 2/3 reviewers (security-guardian, cpp-safety), not solely by test coverage.

trigger: any list_profiles dispatch rendered in the dashboard's primary results table once a schema-only definition resolves (i.e. after the dashboard-rendering fix in the same PR landed)
summary: render_profile_row emitted a leading "profile|" discriminator tag with no per-plugin entry in split_fields to strip it, so every real field rendered one column right of its header and the last field spilled into a sixth, header-less cell. Pre-existing since the original PR1.7 commit; made observable (not introduced) by this PR's own dashboard column-resolution fix widening the header from 2 to 5 columns. The existing test used substring-containment assertions that passed regardless of column alignment.
caused_by: arch-S1/qa-S1 fix (dashboard rendering fix widening columns made this pre-existing defect observable for the first time)

trigger: two concurrent get_user_value dispatches against the same offline (not-logged-in) SID
summary: Fixed offline-mount name (YUZU_HIVE_<sid>, not randomized) means the second concurrent call gets a spurious mount_failed even though the first call already has the data. Surfaced honestly (not silent) via an existing error branch; already a known, accepted, documented limitation per the original remediation plan.
adjudication_rationale: Randomizing the mount name is a real fix but not zero-risk (interacts with the already-verified unload/cleanup RAII); deferred to a tracked hardening issue alongside the other unhappy-path SHOULD findings rather than rushed in this PR's final round. Disclosed in agent-plugins.md so operators aren't surprised by it.

trigger: a live profile's ProfileImagePath exceeding the fixed 512-wchar read buffer
summary: RegQueryValueExW returns ERROR_MORE_DATA (not ERROR_SUCCESS) for an oversized path; profile_image_path silently stays empty with no cap-exceeded signal, unlike kMaxProfiles' truncated warning.

trigger: a REG_MULTI_SZ, REG_NONE, or REG_LINK value read via get_user_value
summary: read_reg_value's default branch hex-encodes any non-string/non-numeric type rather than decoding it (e.g. a double-NUL-terminated REG_MULTI_SZ flattens to an unreadable hex blob) — data-fidelity loss, not a crash or wrong-answer-presented-as-correct.

trigger: RegOpenKeyExW/RegQueryValueExW returning ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED or another non-not-found error under a mounted hive
summary: do_get_user_value's inner RegOpenKeyExW lambda treats any non-ERROR_SUCCESS the same as not-found, so a real ACL/infra fault (stale handle, antivirus lock) is indistinguishable from a genuinely absent key to the operator.

trigger: two-dot diff (origin/dev..HEAD) computed after origin/dev advanced 9 commits past this branch's fork point (PR #2688 plugin ABI4 + capability matrix, PR #2724 cedar-vale fix)
summary: Branch was 9 commits stale against origin/dev; the raw two-dot diff showed phantom deletions of unrelated upstream work. Verified the true (three-dot / merge-base) diff was already clean and touched no proto/sdk files, then rebased cleanly onto current origin/dev with zero conflicts, confirming the ABI4 work is genuinely disjoint from this PR. Full re-verification on both platforms after rebase, including a second real bug this exposed (hp-B1, caught only after rebuild picked up ABI4's version bump).

trigger: CC8.1 change-management evidence chain consisted of commit messages only
summary: This repo's convention requires a Gate-8-authored governance.d/*.jsonl fragment as the CC8.1 evidence record for a /governance run, not just commit-message narration.

trigger: an operator reading agent logs after a hive_unload_failed warning
summary: "locks the profile's NTUSER.DAT until reboot" overstated the failure mode (most leaked-mount unload failures are a transient third-party handle, recoverable without reboot); the warning message itself gave the sid but not the literal mount key or a remediation command.

trigger: a pilot customer reading the get_user_value changelog fragment in isolation
summary: get_user_value has been non-functional for logged-in users since it first shipped (~4.5 months, per git history) — sharpened the fragment to say so explicitly rather than reading as a narrower regression fix.

trigger: an operator hitting the concurrent-mount-collision limitation (up-S1) with no doc explaining it
summary: The concurrent-mount limitation existed only implicitly in code structure, nowhere customer-facing. Disclosed in the get_user_value table row.

No documented error taxonomy for get_user_value's six distinct error/warning strings, and list_profiles' hive_state column values (loaded/not_loaded/loaded_classes_only) are undocumented for operators.
